Hello, Mr. Shirato. My name is Rote (@roteinpu).
Thank you very much for your usual support.

This is my first time to make a request.
I am very sorry if there are any flaws or rudeness.
In that case, please do not hesitate to reject my request.

First of all, the purpose of this request is that we are planning to publish a book of Golden Kamui Koito Otonoshin's dream novels at an event in December or later.
We would like to use Mr. Shirato's beautiful drawings for the front and back covers of the book.
Of course, we will mention Shirato-san's name clearly in the afterword column and when we advertise on Twitter.

If the purpose of using your artwork as the front and back cover of a fanzine is out of the question, we are very sorry.
Please reject this request.

Also, even in the unlikely event that the picture drawn by Mr. Shirato cannot be used as the cover due to the relationship with the printing house or some other reason, I would like to cherish and appreciate it as a treasure in my heart.
Naturally, I will not raise any objections as stipulated in the terms and conditions.

I would like to request the following two illustrations from Mr. Shirato.
I would appreciate your consideration.

(1) Color illustration of Ensign Otonoshin Koito from Golden Kamui
Please provide a picture of Ensign Koito with his upper body naked, smiling and holding out his hand to us (the dreamer or purchaser).
Please keep the upper half of the body naked.
Please leave no scratches on his cheeks.
I love Shirato-san's two pictures of "Fireworks and the Sea" in his "Summer and Kit (July 24, Twitter)". I would be happy to see such an enchanting expression of love for the dreamer.
I would be happy if there are tears at the corner of her eyes.
I would be happy if her cheeks are slightly red.
I am happy if her hair is a little disheveled because she woke up from sleep.
I would like to see the dreamer's pale, thin arms, like in the "Sea Picture" of "Summer and Kit" above.
The background should be vaguely recognizable as being in a Japanese-style room from the Meiji era.
I would appreciate it if the size of the picture could withstand the size of an A6 paperback book (148 x 105 mm), but I will leave this up to Mr. Shirato. As mentioned above, even if the cover cannot be used due to the relationship with the printer or other reasons, we will not raise any objections as per the terms of the agreement.


(2) Color illustration of His Excellency Golden Kamui if matured Otonoshin Koito
Please draw a color illustration of His Excellency the Mature Carp, who has grown up to be in his 40s, dressed in a kimono and smiling as he holds out his hand to us (the dreamer/buyer).
He has scars on his cheeks, his hair is slicked back, his forehead is out, he has a mustache and beard, his muscles are big, and he is sexy and a little charming.
I have seen a few of the mature Koito in the doujin community, but I would like to see a mature Koito drawn by Mr. Shirato.
I would be happy to see a composition of him paired with Ensign Koito on the cover.
I would like to see a pairing between Ensign Koito on the front cover and the matured Koito on the back cover.
I would like to see the dreamer's pale arms on the front cover as well as on the back cover.
I would like to have an image of the two of them strolling in a large garden in the Meiji era. I would like the background to be like that.
I would appreciate it if the size of the cover could withstand A6 paperback size (148 x 105 mm), but I will leave that up to Mr. Shirato. As mentioned above, even if the cover cannot be used due to the relationship with the printer or other reasons, we will not raise any objections as stipulated in the terms and conditions.


The first time I got to know Mr. Shirato was through his Kinkamu pictures, but now I am a fan of his pictures themselves.
I don't know about FGO, but I thought his drawing of Junaguda♀ on Twitter on August 9 was very beautiful and full of love between the two.
If I could publish a dream book with Shirato-san's drawings, nothing would make me happier.

I apologize for the length of this message.
Please take care of yourself and don't get sick during the changing season.
Thank you for your consideration.

さっそくですが、今回白戸さまにお願いしたいのは、

を実行していただくことです。またこの依頼か…と思われたと思いますが…。

白戸さまにお願いをするきっかけが、
先日描かれていらっしゃったフタクチ中尉に一目惚れしてしまったためです。

そもそも、以前から白戸さまの作品は鍵垢からコソコソ拝見させていただいており、大好きな絵柄でそれはもうさまざまな男たちにウハウハしておりました。そんな憧れの絵師さまに、自分のために描いてもらう経験、したい…！！ (ネップリ出して下さりありがとうございました！！激マブチェキとお出かけできて幸せです！)
私自身、絵を描きはするのですが、白戸さまの世界観・デザインでフタクチ中尉と並び立ちたい…！！(依頼人の26とは友人ですので、絡ませる気満々です。)

という願いから依頼に至りました。
どうかフォロワーさま及びフタクチ中尉へのこじらせた愛を救っていただけますと幸いです。乱文失礼いたしました。

以下、私の師団化イメージでございます。
原文ママですので読みづらいかもしれませんが、私の勝手な編集で雰囲気が変わるのが嫌なのでそのまま送らせていただいております。
